name: io.github.swebsy/mcp
description: Build and edit real websites in Swebsy Studio from your coding agent — no per-token AI fees.

environmentVariables.name: SWEBSY_AGENT_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the local relay listens on (default 37373)

environmentVariables.name: SWEBSY_AGENT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where screenshots and exports land (default: .swebsy-agent in the workspace)

environmentVariables.name: SWEBSY_APP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Studio origin used for the pairing link (default https://studio.swebsy.com; set this for local or self-hosted Studio)

environmentVariables.name: SWEBSY_NO_OPEN
environmentVariables.description: Set to skip auto-opening the pairing link in the browser
